title: BVN Slip PDF Sample: Details, Picture, and Printing Guide
excerpt: See what a BVN slip should contain, whether it includes a picture, how to save a clear PDF, and how to print it safely in Nigeria.
keywords: how to print BVN slip with picture

sections.content: A BVN slip is a printable record used to show the Bank Verification Number and the identity details returned by the authorised service. The exact layout can vary by provider or format. Before printing, check that the name, BVN, date of birth, and any photograph shown belong to the correct person and are readable.

Do not use a random online sample as proof of identity. A sample is useful only for understanding the layout. Your valid document must be generated from your own verified BVN record through a legitimate channel. Treat the PDF as sensitive because it can expose identity information useful to fraudsters.
What Information Appears on a BVN Slip?

items: The name stored on the BVN record.
Date of birth or other permitted identity fields, depending on the format.
A photograph when the selected format and source provide one.
A transaction, verification, or generation reference where applicable.
The issuing service's layout or security markings.

sections.content: A bank, employer, school, or service provider may ask for a particular format or a direct electronic verification instead of a printed slip. Ask what it accepts before paying for a premium or card-style version. A decorative plastic card does not replace a live BVN verification when the receiving organisation requires one.
Does a BVN Slip Have a Picture?

Some BVN slip formats show the photograph captured during enrolment, while other verification outputs may focus on the number and demographic details. Choose the format requested by the organisation receiving it. If a slip should contain a photograph but displays a blank space, wrong person, or unclear image, do not edit the PDF yourself. Report the issue to the service that generated it.
How to Get a BVN Slip as a PDF

steps.title: Use a trusted service
steps.content: Choose your bank's documented route or a traceable service such as Ufriends' BVN slip page. Confirm the provider, price, format, and delivery method.

steps.title: Enter only required details
steps.content: Use the secure form. Never send a banking password, card PIN, or OTP to an agent.

steps.title: Verify the preview
steps.content: Check the name, number, date of birth, and photograph before downloading.

steps.title: Save the original PDF
steps.content: Download the file directly instead of taking screenshots. Give it a private filename and store it in a protected folder.

steps.title: Print the correct format
steps.content: Use A4 or card dimensions according to the generated document and the receiving organisation's requirement.

rows: Sharp and readable at normal size
Printer set to crop or enlarge beyond the page
Dark print that hides a photograph or code
All details belong to the applicant

sections.content: What If the BVN Slip Shows Wrong Details?

Generate a fresh copy once to rule out an old cached file. If the wrong detail remains, confirm the central record with your bank. Do not use PDF-editing software to change a name, date, number, or picture. Submit a proper BVN correction and print a new slip after approval. Start with our safe BVN modification guide.
Protect Your BVN Slip and PDF

items: Do not post an unredacted slip on social media or in a public support group.
Use a trusted print shop and delete the local copy from its computer after printing.
Send the document only to the verified contact of the organisation that requested it.
Cover unnecessary fields when a recipient only needs to confirm one detail.
Do not accept a sample template that asks you to type in identity details manually.
Keep the original PDF and transaction reference so you can trace how it was generated.
Is a screenshot the same as the original PDF? No. A screenshot can crop details and lose print quality. Keep the downloaded PDF as the source file.
Must every BVN slip contain a picture? Formats differ. Ask the receiving organisation which output it accepts and choose a legitimate format that contains the requested fields.
Can I correct a spelling error inside the PDF? No. Correct the central BVN record, then generate a new document from the updated data.
Is a plastic BVN card always required? No. Some organisations accept a standard printout or live verification. Confirm the requirement before paying for a premium format.
Can a business centre print the file for me? Yes, but use a trusted operator, remain present, and ask for the downloaded copy to be deleted from the shop's computer afterward.
